name: Canadian Street Types
description: Canada Post's English street types in full and abbreviated, and its French street types, which come before the street name. The type is expected as the library reports it everywhere: the USPS standard abbreviation where USPS Publication 28 Appendix C1 has the word (Court is Ct, Lane is Ln), otherwise Canada Post's abbreviation (Concession is Conc, chemin is Ch). Shapes follow Canada Post's Addressing Guidelines, described in our own words; every input is constructed for this corpus, and no table is copied from Canada Post.
